body:
## Context

[temporalio/api#751](https://github.com/temporalio/api/pull/751) deprecates the `namespace` field on the following Protobuf command attribute messages, following Temporal Server 1.30.1 disabling cross-namespace operations by default (behind `system.enableCrossNamespaceCommands`):

- `RequestCancelExternalWorkflowExecutionCommandAttributes`
- `SignalExternalWorkflowExecutionCommandAttributes`
- `StartChildWorkflowExecutionCommandAttributes`

## Work needed

Once api#751 is merged and the API submodule is updated, reflect the deprecation in the Go SDK by marking the corresponding Go-level option fields/structs as deprecated. Specifically:

- `ChildWorkflowOptions.Namespace` (used in `workflow.ExecuteChildWorkflow`)
- The `Namespace` field on external cancel/signal options (if exposed at the workflow API level)

Add `// Deprecated: Cross-namespace operations are disabled by default as of server 1.30.1.` doc comments to each.

## References

- API deprecation PR: temporalio/api#751
- Server change: temporalio/temporal#8971
- Tracking issue: temporalio/api#750
title: Deprecate namespace fields on cross-namespace workflow command options
